name: Stored-energy discharged indication
summary: Reports the mechanism's documented discharged condition for control or maintenance indication.
description: Reports the mechanism's documented discharged condition for control or maintenance indication. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Discharged-position contact” at the input and “Stored-energy state” at the output. This signal does not establish all stored energy is absent.

Show the individual contacts and the relevant motor or release circuit. Supply voltage, charging time, operating duty and permissible alarms must follow the chosen mechanism documentation.
